scenicChapters.title: Halsema Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 49 km this is Halsema Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Halsema Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 60 km. 2255 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Highest Point → Bontoc
scenicChapters.narrative: 2255 m come off over 75 km at around 5.1%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
